context.goal: Replace the paper maintenance log for a 22-turbine onshore wind farm with a tablet app that technicians use on the turbine.
context.audience: Technicians, the site manager, the HSE officer and the asset owner's engineer, who will answer the list.

items.meaning: Open a job on a WTG from the tablet; types: scheduled service, fault, inspection, retrofit.
items.row: open a job on a WTG from the tablet, job types: scheduled service, fault, inspection, retrofit

items.meaning: The LOTO checklist is completed and signed by 2 technicians before a job can go to in progress, no exceptions.
items.row: LOTO checklist must be completed and signed by 2 techs before the job can go to "in progress" (no exceptions, HSE)

items.meaning: Nacelle work logs the climb, the harness check and the second person on the ground.
items.row: nacelle work: log the climb, the harness check, and who is the second person on the ground

items.meaning: Parts used are scanned by barcode from the container inventory, with a warning below minimum stock.
items.row: parts used: scan the part barcode, stock comes from the container inventory, warns when a part drops below min stock

items.meaning: Time per job per technician is recorded for OEM warranty claims.
items.row: time per job per tech, for the OEM warranty claims they want the hours

items.meaning: Before and after photos attach to the job, at most 10, compressed on the tablet.
items.row: photos: before / after, attached to the job, max 10, compressed on the tablet

items.meaning: The job report is a PDF in the OEM template so warranty claims are accepted.
items.row: the job report is a PDF in the OEM format (they have a template, see attached, not attached sorry) so the warranty people accept it

items.meaning: A fault job links to the SCADA alarm that triggered it by alarm id.
items.row: SCADA alarm that triggered a fault job is linked to the job by alarm id, we type the id now

items.meaning: The app works without signal in the nacelle and syncs at the base.
items.row: works with no signal up in the nacelle, syncs at the base

items.meaning: The site manager sees open jobs by WTG and by technician, with overdue scheduled services marked in a configurable colour.
items.row: site manager sees all open jobs by WTG and by tech, overdue scheduled services in red; M.D.: the overdue colour, make it configurable not red, we have a colour blind tech

items.meaning: HSE gets a monthly export of all LOTO records and near misses.
items.row: HSE officer: monthly export of all LOTO records and near misses

items.meaning: Near miss report: what, where, photo, from any technician; anonymous to the site, visible to HSE.
items.row: near miss report: 3 fields, what, where, photo, from any tech, anonymous option; M.D.: anonymous to the site, visible to HSE, otherwise we cannot follow up

items.meaning: The app shows SCADA wind speed and blocks opening a nacelle job above 15 m/s.
items.row: weather: the app shows wind speed from SCADA and blocks opening a nacelle job above 12 m/s; M.D.: the wind limit is 15 m/s for nacelle work per the OEM manual, 12 is for the rotor

items.meaning: Retrofit jobs carry the OEM bulletin number.
items.row: retrofit jobs from the OEM bulletin need the bulletin number on the job

must_not_invent: a 12 m/s limit for nacelle work (corrected to 15)
overdue jobs shown in red (corrected to configurable)
spare parts ordering from the OEM
notes: Context spec (decision 0011). Glossary terms WTG, LOTO, SCADA, nacelle, HSE and OEM stay as written; "turbine" for WTG is accepted only in addition, never instead. The corrections at the bottom override the list: 15 m/s, configurable colour, anonymous to the site but visible to HSE. G06-07 is flagged ambiguous because the template is missing. The 12 m/s rotor limit is not an item; it is an explanation.
